Instead of synthesizing the available information or realizing the search strategy was flawed (searching for "list of podiums" when the results only mentioned "wins"), the Planner initiated a redundant and ineffective loop of searches focusing solely on Pedro Rodríguez, ignoring the possibility that the answer might be "None" or requiring a different verification method. This pattern of repeating similar queries without resolving the core ambiguity or synthesizing the existing data matches the error pattern seen in Example 3 (repeated actions without advancing understanding) and Example 5 (excessive iterations on redundant queries).
